questions.question: In Solomon's Song of Songs, a woman tells others not to stare because she is dark. What does she say made her dark?

answers.text: The sun has gazed upon her
The smoke has settled on her
The wind has swept over her

questions.question: In Solomon's Song of Songs, the woman's mother's sons were angry with her. What did they make her keeper of?
A man in Solomon's Song of Songs calls his darling a lily among thorns. What is he saying about her?

answers.text: She stands out from all the rest
She is quieter than all the rest
She is younger than all the rest

questions.question: In Solomon's Song of Songs, why does the woman ask to be sustained with raisins and refreshed with apples?

answers.text: She is weary from the road
She is weak from the heat
